messages:
ops-bot: Pager: HIGH - runtime-serving errors spike for model redwood/llm-7b at 2025-11-02T09:12Z. All on-call notified. /page oncall-sre-jack :rotating_light:

oncall-sre-jack: seeing increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate, GC chatter on pods. I'm joining bridge.

alice-engineering: jumping in — can someone paste the failing log samples?

ben-support: customer reports: "requests returning 502 intermittently since 09:10Z" — affected: hosted customers in eu-west-1.

carla-product: ETA for customer impact estimate? we need rough count for comms.

oncall-sre-jack: quick numbers: ~3% error rate across traffic, peak 8% for ~3 minutes. Routing fallback kicked in for some tenants. Not full outage.

ops-bot: Bridge started: https://meet.internal/bridge/1916004321 (ops-bot joined)

alice-engineering: attaching logs — truncated: 
```
[09:11:42] runtime: kv-cache fetch miss for key shard-12
[09:11:43] runtime: attempt=1 model=llm-7b seq=1024 oom=false latency=201ms error=serialize failed
[09:11:44] kernel: cuda launch warning: small batch size
[09:12:01] runtime: request-retry trigger fallback variant llm-7b-quantized
```

dinesh-ml: hypothesis 1: quantized variant fallback has a serialization bug under mixed batch sizes. hypothesis 2: prefix cache eviction thrash leading to corrupted KV reads.

oncall-sre-jack: quick mitigation applied: reduced concurrent streams on node pool and pinned routing to non-quantized variant for sensitive tenants.

carla-product: ok we should draft a status page update — short, factual, no blame. I'll draft.

maya-commops: I'll help with wording and stakeholder notify list. who owns customer outreach for enterprise tenants?

ben-support: I will own enterprise outreach (APAC + EMEA customers affected). I need the window and ETA.

oncall-sre-jack: current window: 09:10Z - ongoing, impact small percent of requests, mitigation active at 09:18Z. Monitoring shows error rate decreasing.

ops-bot: Note: oncall handoff scheduled at 12:00Z. If we do hotfix, coordinate before handoff or include in notes.

alice-engineering: I have a repro harness to hit fallback variant locally. Attaching minimal repro steps: 
```bash
# repro sequence
python repro.py --model llm-7b --seq 1024 --concurrency 12 --prefetch 0
```
Include logs to /tmp/repro.log and grep for "serialize failed".
```
```

dinesh-ml: I'll instrument additional KV safety checks and add log counters for corrupted reads. Deploying a non-disruptive patch to canary at 09:45Z.

eva-security: any sensitive data in logs? ensure we scrub tokens before sharing externally.

alice-engineering: logs above scrubbed. we'll provide a sanitized extract in comms.

carla-product: DRAFT statuspage (short):
"At 09:10 UTC we observed an increase in 5xx errors for model inference in eu-west-1. We applied mitigations (routing to stable model variant and reduced concurrency) at 09:18 UTC which reduced error rates. We are investigating root cause and will post an RCA."

maya-commops: suggested edits to be explicit on impact and next update window: 
"Update 09:30 UTC: Error rates have reduced to baseline for most customers; a small subset continued seeing intermittent errors until 09:22 UTC. Next update by 12:00 UTC or on resolution."

ben-support: OK to send to enterprise list with that wording + note about potential data scrubbing?

eva-security: confirm no PII. good to go.

oncall-sre-jack: timeline notes for RCA thread:
- 09:10Z: spike detected by runtime metrics and customer reports
- 09:11Z: first serialization errors observed in pod logs
- 09:14Z: routing started shifting to fallback variants automatically
- 09:18Z: manual mitigation: pinning to non-quantized variant + reduce concurrent streams
- 09:22Z: error rate back to ~0.4% baseline for most customers
- 09:45Z: canary patch rolling with additional KV checks

alice-engineering: adding hypotheses in-thread: [quantized-serialization-bug, kv-eviction-thrash, kernel-scheduling-race]. We'll mark with status: investigating/confirmed/mitigated as we go.

ops-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: 5, :eyes: 2 on the bridge thread.

carla-product: stakeholder notify plan: product + sales + trust to be DM'd with impact list. Exec send? only if over 10% tenant impact — not required.

maya-commops: I'll prepare two templates: enterprise email + public status page blurb. Draft here: 
"We experienced intermittent inference errors affecting a small subset of requests in eu-west-1 between 09:10 and 09:22 UTC. We’ve applied mitigations and are investigating the root cause. If you notice continued problems please contact support."

ben-support: sending enterprise notices now to affected customers list.

dinesh-ml: canary metrics look clean so far. will collect additional traces for hypothesis correlation.

oncall-sre-jack: handoff note for incoming oncall at 12:00Z:
"Incident 1916004321: transient 5xx spike for llm-7b in eu-west-1. Mitigated by variant pinning and concurrency reduction. Canary patch deployed. Primary hypotheses: quantized serialization bug / KV eviction. Continued traces and RCA expected. See bridge logs and /var/logs/runtime/1916004321.log (sanitized)."

alice-engineering: leaving a troubleshooting checklist for next oncall: 
- check pod logs for "serialize failed"
- confirm routing table pinned to stable variants
- validate KV cache counters per shard
- review canary traces for any residual errors

maya-commops: scheduled stakeholder update at 12:05Z if RCA not complete. sending status page now.

ops-bot: Incident note saved: https://incidents.internal/1916004321 (ops-bot)

carla-product: thanks team. closing live bridge in 10m once monitoring fully stable. keep thread for RCA buildout.

ben-support: confirmed customers acknowledged enterprise note. no escalations so far.

dinesh-ml: leaving logs and hypothesis markers in RCA doc. will link here once ready.

oncall-sre-jack: marking incident as mitigated for live traffic at 09:30Z; RCA in progress.

ops-bot: Bridge ended: 1916004321 at 10:02Z.
